futurescapes.name: Worldwide IT Industry
futurescapes.title: IDC FutureScape: Worldwide IT Industry 2019 Predictions
futurescapes.note: Table of contents read from an Internet Archive copy.

futurescapes.name: Worldwide CIO Agenda
futurescapes.title: IDC FutureScape: Worldwide CIO Agenda 2019 Predictions
futurescapes.note: Table of contents read from an Internet Archive copy.

entries.quote: By 2022, 60%+ of Global GDP Will Be Digitized, with Growth in Every Industry Driven by Digitally Enhanced Offerings, Operations, and Relationships and Almost $7 Trillion in IT-Related Spending in 2019–2022
entries.subject: Digitized global GDP
entries.metric: share of global GDP digitized

entries.quote: By 2023, 75% of All IT Spending Will Be on 3rd Platform Technologies, as Over 90% of All Enterprises Build "Digital Native" IT Environments to Thrive in the Digital Economy
entries.subject: 3rd Platform share of IT spending
entries.metric: share of IT spending on 3rd Platform technologies

entries.quote: By 2022, Over 40% of Organizations' Cloud Deployments Will Include Edge Computing and 25% of Endpoint Devices and Systems Will Execute AI Algorithms
entries.subject: Edge computing in cloud deployments
entries.metric: share of organizations' cloud deployments including edge computing
entries.note: Also: 25% of endpoint devices and systems execute AI algorithms.

entries.quote: By 2022, 90% of All New Apps Will Feature Microservices Architectures That Improve the Ability to Design, Debug, Update, and Leverage Third-Party Code; 35% of All Production Apps Will Be Cloud Native
entries.subject: Microservices architectures
entries.metric: share of new apps with microservices architectures
entries.note: Also: 35% of production apps cloud native.

entries.quote: By 2024, a New Class of Professional Developers Producing Code Without Custom Scripting Will Expand the Developer Population by 30%, Accelerating Digital Transformation
entries.subject: Low-code developers
entries.metric: growth in developer population from developers producing code without custom scripting

entries.quote: From 2018 to 2023 — with New Tools/Platforms, More Developers, Agile Methods, and Lots of Code Reuse — 500 Million New Logical Apps Will Be Created, Equal to the Number Built Over the Past 40 Years
entries.subject: New logical apps
entries.metric: number of new logical apps created 2018-2023

entries.quote: By 2022, 25% of Public Cloud Computing Will Be Based on Non-x86 Processors (Including Quantum); by 2022, Organizations Will Spend More on Vertical SaaS Apps than Horizontal Apps
entries.subject: Non-x86 cloud compute
entries.metric: share of public cloud computing on non-x86 processors
entries.note: Also: vertical SaaS spend exceeds horizontal apps by 2022.

entries.quote: By 2024, AI-Enabled User Interfaces and Process Automation Will Replace One-Third of Today's Screen-Based Apps; by 2022, 30% of Enterprises Will Use Conversational Speech Tech for Customer Engagement
entries.subject: AI-enabled interfaces
entries.metric: share of screen-based apps replaced by AI-enabled UIs and process automation
entries.note: Also: by 2022, 30% of enterprises use conversational speech tech for customer engagement.

entries.quote: By 2022, 50% of Servers Will Encrypt Data at Rest and in Motion, Over 50% of Security Alerts Will Be Handled by AI-Powered Automation, and 150 Million People Will Have Blockchain-Based Digital Identities
entries.subject: Encryption, AI security, blockchain identity
entries.metric: share of servers encrypting data at rest and in motion
entries.note: Also: over 50% of security alerts handled by AI automation; 150 million people with blockchain-based digital identities.

entries.quote: By 2022, the Top 4 Cloud "Megaplatforms" Will Host 80% of IaaS/PaaS Deployments, But by 2024, 90% of G1000 Organizations Will Mitigate Lock-In Through Multicloud/Hybrid Technologies and Tools
entries.subject: Cloud megaplatform concentration
entries.metric: share of IaaS/PaaS deployments hosted by top 4 cloud megaplatforms
entries.note: Also: by 2024, 90% of G1000 mitigate lock-in through multicloud/hybrid tools.

entries.quote: By 2021, Driven by LOB Needs, 70% of CIOs Will Deliver "Agile Connectivity" via APIs and Architectures That Interconnect Digital Solutions from Cloud Vendors, System Developers, Start-Ups, and Others
entries.subject: Agile connectivity via APIs
entries.metric: share of CIOs delivering agile connectivity via APIs

entries.quote: Compelled to Curtail IT Spending, Improve Enterprise IT Agility, and Accelerate Innovation, 70% of CIOs Will Aggressively Apply Data and AI to IT Operations, Tools, and Processes by 2021
entries.subject: AI for IT operations
entries.metric: share of CIOs applying data and AI to IT operations

entries.quote: By 2022, 65% of Enterprises Will Task CIOs to Transform and Modernize Governance Policies to Seize the Opportunities and Confront New Risks Posed by AI, ML, and Data Privacy and Ethics
entries.subject: AI and data governance
entries.metric: share of enterprises tasking CIOs to modernize governance for AI, ML, privacy and ethics

entries.quote: Through 2022, 75% of Successful Digital Strategies Will Be Built by a Transformed IT Organization, with Modernized and Rationalized Infrastructure, Applications, and Data Architectures
entries.subject: IT-built digital strategies
entries.metric: share of successful digital strategies built by a transformed IT organization

entries.quote: By 2020, 80% of IT Executive Leadership Will Be Compensated Based on Business KPIs and Metrics That Measure IT's Effectiveness in Driving Business Performance and Growth, Not IT Operational Measures
entries.subject: Business KPIs in IT compensation
entries.metric: share of IT executive leadership compensated on business KPIs

entries.quote: By 2020, 60% of CIOs Will Initiate a Digital Trust Framework That Goes Beyond Preventing Cyberattacks and Enables Organizations to Resiliently Rebound from Adverse Situations, Events, and Effects
entries.subject: Digital trust framework
entries.metric: share of CIOs initiating a digital trust framework

entries.quote: By 2022, 75% of CIOs Who Do Not Shift Their Organizations to Empowered IT Product Teams to Enable Digital Innovation, Disruption, and Scale Will Fail in Their Roles
entries.subject: Empowered IT product teams
entries.metric: share of CIOs who fail by not shifting to empowered IT product teams

entries.quote: Through 2022, the Talent Pool for Emerging Technologies Will Be Inadequate to Fill at Least 30% of Global Demand and Effective Skills Development and Retention Will Become Differentiating Strategies
entries.subject: Emerging tech talent gap
entries.metric: share of global demand for emerging technology talent left unfilled

entries.quote: By 2021, 65% of CIOs Will Expand Agile/DevOps Practices into the Wider Business to Achieve the Velocity Necessary for Innovation, Execution, and Change
entries.subject: Agile/DevOps beyond IT
entries.metric: share of CIOs expanding agile/DevOps into the wider business

entries.quote: By 2023, 70% of CIOs Who Cannot Manage the IT Governance, Strategy, and Operations Divides Between LOB-Dominated Edge Computing, Operational Technology, and IT Will Fail Professionally
entries.subject: Edge, OT and IT governance
entries.metric: share of CIOs who fail professionally by not managing edge/OT/IT divides
